purpose: Stage 2b regression fixture. A term span must end at the real noun-phrase boundary: not swallow the next word ('the vehicle together'), and not stop early at a binding preposition ('a level of understanding' -> 'level'). The us12677034 fixture does not exercise this. Each case lists terms that must be extracted, as [kind, normalized], and over-grouped or truncated forms that must not be.

cases.text: a vehicle and a trailer coupled to the vehicle
a spring or a clip, wherein the spring is steel
determining a level of understanding of a category; and storing the level of understanding
a plurality of pins, wherein the pins are metal
a pair of distance sensors; and a controller coupled to the pair of distance sensors
a frame of the vehicle and a wheel of said vehicle
the processor of claim 1, wherein the processor is fast
a sensor for the vehicle; a bracket with a bolt; a signal to the controller; a reading from the sensor; a pin in the housing; a label on the lid
a solid axle connecting a left wheel and a right wheel of the vehicle together;
holding a wheel assembly of the vehicle stationary while a stationary rail moves
the solid axle connects rear wheels of the vehicle
the pair of distance sensors each generate sensor signals that are indicative of distances
the pair of dampers include one of the following: active dampers and semiactive dampers
